profile_text.body:
Repurpose is the company behind Repurpose.io, a content distribution and repurposing platform it describes as the number one automated content repurposing and distribution platform. According to its site, the product is built to save time and simplify sharing content, letting users publish consistently to Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other destinations. The company was founded in 2017.

The site presents Repurpose.io as a multi-platform tool with workflow automation and API access. It offers a free tier that allows publishing 10 videos without a credit card, after which users can move to a paid plan for more accounts, higher limits and premium automation features. The company's own framing of the product is promotional, and the specific limits and features described are those it advertises on its website.
